scripts.format: pnpm run-all format && pnpm components:format && prettier eslint.config.js --write

scripts.components:lint: node tools/doc-check.mjs && node tools/release-check.mjs && node tools/check-example-assets.mjs && eslint "tools/{check-example-assets,check-spacetime-release,consumer-install-check,doc-check,release-check,release-packages,run-example-builds,run-example-smokes,run-example-tests,run-module-builds,run-package-checks,run-production-audits}.mjs" tools/example-server-identity.ts && pnpm -r --filter "./spacetime-*-ts" run lint
scripts.components:build: pnpm components:toolchain:check && pnpm --dir crates/bindings-typescript run build && node tools/run-module-builds.mjs && node tools/run-example-builds.mjs
scripts.components:test:cron:local: pnpm --dir spacetime-cron-ts run test:module:local && pnpm --dir spacetime-cron-ts run test:recovery
scripts.components:check: pnpm components:lint && pnpm components:test && pnpm components:consumer:check
scripts.components:release:check:local: pnpm components:check && pnpm components:build && pnpm components:audit:prod && pnpm components:test:cron:local && pnpm components:smoke:examples:ephemeral
